verified_facts.text: Thompson Madrid is set beside Plaza del Carmen, moments from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Gran Via and Plaza de Espana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set beside Plaza del Carmen, just moments from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Gran Vía and Plaza de España

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool is seasonal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal rooftop pool

verified_facts.text: Makaa is the hotel's rooftop restaurant, combining Mediterranean cuisine, open-fire cooking and panoramic city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Makáá, Thompson Madrid’s rooftop restaurant, where Mediterranean cuisine, open-fire cooking and panoramic city views come together.

verified_facts.text: Jack's Club is an intimate piano bar inspired by classic speakeasies and a private library, with live jazz and signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into Jack’s Club, an intimate piano bar inspired by classic speakeasies and the timeless charm of a private library. Rich décor, live jazz and expertly crafted signature cocktails

verified_facts.text: La Barra de Ultramarines is a traditional Spanish tapas bar inside the hotel with tapas made for sharing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the lively atmosphere of a traditional Spanish bar at Barra de Ultramarines, where tapas are made for sharing

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Bar offers a signature vermouth experience paired with a traditional Spanish tortilla.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the hotel’s signature vermouth experience, perfectly paired with a traditional Spanish tortilla

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the convenience of 24-hour in-room dining at Thompson Madrid

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites use wood, leather and marble with residential-inspired design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by residential living, our guestrooms and suites are rooted in local character, bringing together natural wood, leather and marble with contemporary design.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have D.S. & Durga bath amenities and a rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: with high-end extras: luxury linens, D.S. & Durga bath amenities, a rain shower and more

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a minifridge stocked with locally sourced products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minifridge with locally sourced products

verified_facts.text: Thompson Terrace Suite and Penthouse guests can borrow handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA.
verified_facts.excerpt: you will also have exclusive access to handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA, available to borrow as you explore the city

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse occupies the top floor and has a private balcony overlooking landmarks including Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private balcony overlooking landmarks including Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace

verified_facts.text: Select rooms and suites have private terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large windows and private terraces in select accommodations offer panoramic views across the city

verified_facts.text: The building was designed by the firm Lopez y Tena and its most notable feature is two large central courtyards.
verified_facts.excerpt:
The most notable feature of the building, designed by the firm
López y Tena
, is its two large central courtyards which allow light to enter

verified_facts.text: Works by local artists hang on the walls, each artist with a different floor dedicated to them.
verified_facts.excerpt: works by local artists including Andrea Torres, Marta Bermejo, Pils Ferrer, Mercedes Garrido, and Miguel Vallinas hang from the walls—each has a different floor dedicated to them

verified_facts.text: The hotel's carpeting pays homage to Madrid's cobblestoned streets.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s carpeting pays an homage to Madrid’s cobblestoned streets

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24-hour fitness center

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes both dogs and cats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thompson Madrid, by Hyatt, is a pet-friendly hotel that welcomes both dogs and cats.

verified_facts.text: A Two-Bedroom Family Suite connects a King Suite City View and a King City View guestroom via a private corridor.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private corridor connects a King Suite City View with a King City View guestroom

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located within Madrid Central, the city's low-emission zone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that Thompson Madrid is located within Madrid Central, the city’s low-emission zone.

verified_facts.text: Self-parking is at the public Telpark Plaza del Carmen car park with reserved spaces and an exclusive elevator directly to the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Clearly marked spaces reserved for hotel guests are available, with an exclusive elevator offering direct access to the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 16 kilometers from Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport (MAD)

16 Kilometers

verified_facts.text: Restaurants at the hotel (Makaa, Barra de Ultramarines, Jack's Club) are not eligible for World of Hyatt points.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that this outlet is not eligible for World of Hyatt points.

verified_facts.text: The nearest metro stations are Gran Via and Sol.
verified_facts.excerpt: Simply hop on the metro at nearby Gran Vía or Sol station.
